newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX Hub natgas called lower ahead of expiration.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX Hub natgas called lower ahead of expiration.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open lower Tuesday ahead of August's expiration and cooler weather forecasts, market sources said.
August over-the-counter trade ranged from $2.165 to $2.17 at 0930 EDT after settling Monday at $2.183 per million British thermal units.

Cooler weather is now blanketing most of the Northeast and Midwest and is expected to continue over the next couple of days before returning to warmer levels late this week, according to Weather Services Corp.
Chart traders said August support was at $2.145 and then at $2.07 and the $2.051 low from July 8. Resistance was pegged at $2.175 and then at $2.20 and the $2.29 and $2.36 prominent highs.
Taking a look ahead, traders said September support was at last week's low of $2.045, while resistance was seen first along the down trendline in the high-teens and then at $2.20.

In Monday's cash, Gulf Coast prices slipped several cents to the mid-teens, with gas at the Hub quoted in the high-teens. Midcon pipes were down four to five cents around $2.10. New York city gate gas was flat to up slightly at $2.40-2.41.
Separately, injection estimates for Wednesday's American Gas Association storage report are about 76 bcf.
